_about: Spoken lines that belong to no one fighter (announcer calls, the default intro). Each fighter's own speaker and lines (its intro, finisher line and the announcer's '<name> wins') live in src/fighters/<id>/voice.json; src/audio/voicemanifest.ts merges them all. scripts/gen_voices.py renders each one with Kokoro TTS (stock voices only) into public/voices/<file>.mp3. The game matches a line by its exact text, so edit the text in the JSON and in the code together, then re-run the script. Each speaker must sound distinct: a Kokoro voice no other speaker uses, or one whose pitch differs by 0.1+ (tests/voicelines.test.ts enforces it; scripts/casting.py prints the casting table): pick an unused one that fits the character's gender and accent. Voice ids: a/b = American/British English, f/m = female/male; other language packs (e.g. ff_siwis French) read the English text with that accent. 'spoken' overrides what the TTS reads when the subtitle text would read badly.
